_meta.rf_framing_note: [GOVERNANCE] Pediatric safety content (Reye/aspirin, codeine-tramadol black box, tetracycline/FQ age limits, SSRI suicidality, stimulant monitoring) — mainstream [LBL]/[GL]. Энергетический overlay (Yang predominant, constitution forming, M-A baseline) и особенно ACEs↔AIRE/'childhood interventions shape adult constitution' — RF/SPECULATIVE гипотезы; research-only; не операционализировано; не patient-facing. ACEs↔AIRE overlap явно помечен источником как возможно спекулятивный (logic-review issue 1).

energy_perspective: Yang predominant — high metabolic activity, active growth [RF]
Constitution forming — interventions могут shape long-term patterns [RF, SPECULATIVE]
KCTS rare в young children — AIRE-triggers usually develop later [RF]
class_notes.less_is_more: [RF/Mark] Iatrogenic interventions в childhood могут affect adult constitution (chronic meds, repeated antibiotics, long-term steroids) — 'less is more' principle particularly relevant в pediatrics. [GOVERNANCE: conceptually-strong claim, hypothesis only.]
class_notes.aces_aire_overlap_rf: [RF, SPECULATIVE] Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs) research conceptually overlaps с AIRE/KCTS concept: multiple ACEs predict adult chronic disease/mental health; family stress/attachment create lifelong patterns; early intervention may prevent adult KCTS development. NOVEL integration — flagged by source as possibly speculative (Q for Mark). NOT a validated equivalence; ACEs = mainstream validated construct, AIRE = Hamer-derived unvalidated.

drugs.concept: [GL] Core pediatric prescribing principles + drugs to avoid.
core_principles: [GL] Right drug, right dose, right indication
[GL] Long-term effects unknown — особенно для newer drugs
drugs_to_avoid: [LBL] Aspirin <16 yr (Reye's syndrome) — exceptions: Kawasaki, post-cardiac surgery, lupus с adult guidance
[LBL] Codeine <12 yr (FDA 2017 black box) — variable CYP2D6, ultrarapid metabolizers → fatal opioid toxicity; alternatives: acetaminophen, ibuprofen, oxycodone (caution)
[LBL] Tramadol <12 yr (same CYP2D6 concerns, FDA contraindicated)
[LBL] Promethazine <2 yr (severe respiratory depression, FDA black box)
[LBL] Tetracyclines <8 yr (permanent tooth discoloration, bone growth) — exceptions: anthrax, tickborne
[LBL] Fluoroquinolones <18 yr (cartilage/tendon signal) — exceptions: complicated UTI, CF exacerbations, anthrax — specialist decisions
pediatric_specific_considerations: [LBL] SSRIs: suicidal ideation black box <25 yr; fluoxetine FDA approved >8 для depression
[LBL] Stimulants для ADHD: growth velocity monitoring, cardiac history, sleep/appetite effects
[LBL] Antipsychotics: metabolic effects more pronounced, strong indication needed
